description: Source code implementing JSON querying and file access functions for the rdm-agent project, including functions for searching JSON structures, reading JSON files, and utility helpers.

methods.name: is_index
methods.description: Determines if the input string represents an array index, parsed from a path token.

methods.name: cJSON_Search
methods.description: Recursively searches a cJSON structure for a given dot-separated or slash-separated path.

methods.name: cJSON_SearchFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from disk and searches for a specified path within the JSON content.

methods.name: rdmJSONGetAppDetName
methods.description: Parses a JSON file to extract application details including name, version, size, type, and other attributes, setting flags based on JSON content.
